headline: Record year on Uniqlo overseas strength
summary_short: Full-year revenue rose 16.6% y/y to about ¥3.96T and operating profit rose 31.7% to ¥743.1B, led by Uniqlo International (revenue +26.2%).
summary_long: Fast Retailing's year ended Aug 31 2026 showed revenue up 16.6% to about ¥3.96T, operating profit up 31.7% to ¥743.1B and net profit to owners up 25.3% to ¥542.5B. Uniqlo International revenue grew 26.2% to ¥2.41T with operating profit up 44.9%; Uniqlo Japan revenue rose 5.7%; GU revenue rose 1.8%. Full-year dividend was ¥850 per share. Net profit for FY2027 is guided up 3.2% to ¥560B.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from a trade-press article (FashionUnited), not the company filing, and were not cross-checked. Label mismatch: Fast Retailing's fiscal year ends August, so the 2026-10-08 report is the full-year (Q4) result, while the shard labels it FY2026 Q3 (the actual Q3 was reported 2026-07-09). Deltas are full-year y/y, not quarterly. The shard EPS (¥379.46) was not used because its period basis could not be reconciled with the full-year figures.
